title: An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Isometric assembly
scenes.purpose: Show one idea block landing on a shared isometric slab and connecting to four parts of a system, built along fixed iso axes under a locked orthographic camera.
visuals: Three.js true-isometric orthographic diorama: terracotta strata base and 4x4 slate tiles with fine iso grid
Cream-topped terracotta IDEA core block with idea disc
Four cream-topped teal satellite blocks with contact shadows
Terracotta links on the ground axes, teal flow pulses with additive halo
Fixed 2D copy column and dark rounded label tags

beats.development: Strata base rises; 16 slab tiles drop in along the vertical axis back-to-front; kicker and headline lines reveal in the 2D layer.
Terracotta rule and body copy reveal; the IDEA core block drops straight down onto the slab with its contact shadow tightening; IDEA tag appears.
captions: One core block, four links, shared axes.

beats.development: Four links extrude outward along the iso ground axes with junction dots; satellite blocks rise out of the slab along +Y and their tags appear.
Teal flow pulses finish travelling core to satellites and each satellite cap lights on arrival (settled by 2.65s); the complete scene holds.

findings: All motion settles by 2.65s; 0.35s final hold of the complete readable scene.
justifiedHolds: 2.65-3.0s closing hold so the full composition reads as settled.

notes: Silent preview: no music, voice or effects.
No reviewed preview recipe was supplied; the preview demonstrates the primary style with a scene-dependent night background informed by BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json.
